prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: two-state mobile UI design presentation board, concept B for existing oneBeat drum fill grid editor. Generate an original high fidelity flat raster UI mockup, not code. Show two complete tall portrait mobile screens side by side on a quiet pale beige presentation backdrop, same full-height compact music worksheet design, left idle and right playing. Each phone screen proportion 390:844, equally sized, straight-on front view with simple thin ink outlines and minimal frame, no hardware, no 3D perspective. Board approximately landscape 1536x1024. Fit both portrait screens fully, with readable Chinese labels at good size. Tiny outside-screen annotations above the left screen "待试听", above the right screen "播放中 · 自动跟随". Do not put large concept titles or explanation text on the board.

Design direction B: “节拍工作台” is the internal concept, NOT new in-app text. A focused physical rhythm worksheet inspired by a handmade comic music app, crisp flat UI, modest corner radii 8px, black ink near-hard offset shadows 3px, warm cream paper #FFF9EE and offwhite #FFFDF8, main ink #171B1F, warm coral #FF7056, pale lilac #C5B7EB. Tiny restrained scratchy ink accents, very subtle paper grain. Avoid polished generic gradients, avoid 3D, avoid scenic landscape/mascots/large musical instrument illustrations. Distinctive large bold slightly italic Chinese heading within a black ink top band, cream text. Header should feel purposeful, dense and carefully aligned. Plenty of usable grid area, but no huge blank bottom space.

EXACT screen structure BOTH:
1. Top dark ink header about 110 logical px high. Primary cream heading exact "编辑加花" on first line. Second line a small coral outlined tag exact "段落 A" plus cream metadata "4/4". Simple cream close icon "×" at top right, comfortably tappable.
2. Beneath header a compact cream line: left "第 1 小节"; one short helper below it exact "点击格子开关鼓点". A tiny horizontal directional arrow at right may communicate existing horizontal scroll, not a button, no extra words. No more metadata anywhere.
3. Grid area in cream with fixed left labels 64 logical px wide, horizontally scrollable step columns filling right area. EXACTLY EIGHT rows, ALL eight clearly visible legibly in EACH screen. Chinese row labels verbatim in this exact top-to-bottom order: "底鼓", "军鼓", "闭镲", "开镲", "拍手", "低通鼓", "高通鼓", "打击乐". All labels one line, aligned right. Each row height about 49 logical px, thin neutral separators. Small simple ink glyphs optional only if label remains legible; preferred plain typography with tiny coral dash. Header over grid has small beat ruler and step number ruler. Left screen visible step numbers 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8; group them into beat1 and beat2 (top ruler "1 拍", "2 拍"). Right screen is SAME pattern scrolled later, visible step numbers 9 10 11 12 13 14 15 16; top ruler "3 拍", "4 拍". This is a 16-step 4/4 bar, only8step columns fit a phone viewport. Fixed labels never scroll.
4. Each cell a rounded rectangular hit pad, off cells warm neutral light gray/beige, thin ink outline. Active main beats coral and active subdivisions lilac. Make believable sparse drum fill arrangement, no random all-on checkerboard. Bottom rows should also have some hits. Vertical light beat separators before1/5 and9/13 stronger. No buttons over cells.
5. In right playing screen only: a vivid thin coral vertical playback cursor at step12 stretching continuously from ruler through ALL eight instrument rows, above cells, 2 logical px wide, small inverted triangular top marker. Make coral line high contrast, not obscured by active cells. Shows current progress. Later columns9-16 and bottom scroll thumb shifted right visibly demonstrate auto-follow; no extra auto-follow toggle. Left no playback cursor.
6. Under the grid a small horizontal scrollbar track from after fixed labels to right edge, dark thumb in left half for idle and right half for playing.
7. Bottom anchored cream action area separated by a hand-ink black divider. Exactly three touch buttons in one horizontal row, same overall width/padding as grid. Left outline cream "取消"; middle lilac with black triangle play icon and exact "试听" on idle, lilac with black square stop icon and exact "停止" on playing; right largest coral filled "应用到加花" black bold text. Buttons height about48logicalpx, right button approximately twice width of either left. Keep all three labels legible. Give buttons offset ink shadows and crisp outline. Home-indicator thin black bar at very bottom only.

Use ONLY described current product features and text. ABSOLUTELY NO BPM, no tempo controls/knobs, no saved state, no save button, no add tracks, no delete, no mute/solo, no velocity sliders, no row menus, no toolbar, no extra transport, no separate page name, no extra informational badges. Only8 instruments, no additional rows or missing rows. Pair should visibly look like a precise mobile music editor suitable for real implementation, not a loose illustrated poster. Focus on hierarchy, touch spacing, sharp grid alignment and handmade comic personality.
STRICT FINAL AUDIT EMPHASIS: Active cells may be coral ONLY at first subdivision of each beat, i.e steps1 and5 on left, steps9 and13 on right. Every active cell at step2/3/4/6/7/8 or step10/11/12/14/15/16 must be LILAC, regardless of instrument. Particularly the open hihat active step8 and step16 must be lilac. Put playback triangle ABOVE the numbered step ruler, not covering numeral12. EXACT phone frame height:width ratio 844:390 = 2.164. Example on1536x1024canvas: frame left x280to690, y55to945 =>410wide890high; frame right x855to1265, y55to945 =>410wide890high. Total8steps each screen must still fit with fixed labels about64logicalpx. All8rows visible. This means each frame intentionally tall and narrow, no tablet ratio. Keep the gridcompact enough; label text may be modestly smaller but crisp. Explanatory annotations sit outside above frames. No white 'phone screen' border around internal screenshot.
inspection: Both screens contain all8 correct instrument labels. Idle shows steps1to8 and preview; playing shows9to16, stop, full-height coral cursor at12 and scrollbar follow. Coral active cells appear only at step1/5 and9/13. No added product feature.
